title: zeta_gundam
body:
The 1985 TV sequel to [[Mobile Suit Gundam]]. It was created by largely the same creative staff as its predecessor, but veteran designer [[Ookawara Kunio]] was assisted in mechanical designs by newcomers [[Nagano Mamoru]] and [[Fujita Kazumi]]. It also had character designs by [[Kitazume Hiroyuki]] and [[Yasuhiko Yoshikazu]]. 

[i]Zeta Gundam[/i] followed in the footsteps of [[Choujikuu Yousai Macross]] (1982) by including a large number of transforming [[mobile suit]] [[robot]]s, a first for a [[Gundam]] show.

It is set in the year [b]Universal Century 0087[/b], eight years after the original series. It follows the story of [[Kamille Bidan]], designer and pilot of the MSZ-006 [[Zeta Gundam (Mobile Suit)|]], in an interplanetary conflict known as "The [[Gryps]] War", between the oppressive and brutal Earth Federation [[Titans (gundam)|]] against the alliance of the valiant [[AEUG]] and the Karaba resistance organization.

The story of the series continues directly into [[Gundam ZZ]] (and [[Char's Counterattack]], where it concludes).
